findings.root_cause: The UI timeout path mutates local state without querying the durable versioned SDK Run or waiting for an authoritative terminal acknowledgement.
evidence: The UI currently clears inflight and active_run_id before the backend acknowledges anything.
session_health_check only logs and acknowledges client claims; it neither queries nor mutates the SDK Run.
RunClient.query returns the durable versioned RunRecord and genuine WAITING may represent provider reconciliation.

minimal_protocol.request: Send session_run_status_query with query/session/root/sdk run IDs, observed version/status and stuck duration.
minimal_protocol.backend_rules: Resolve and query the durable SDK Run; return a versioned projection with state, waiting reason, allowed actions, retryability and terminal event reference. Recognized waiting remains waiting; unowned waiting exposes cancel.
minimal_protocol.ui_ack_ordering: Keep active_run_id until a matching non-stale authoritative acknowledgement. Apply terminal and clear inflight atomically; show waiting/recovery instead of fake progress or idle.
minimal_protocol.cancel_protocol: chat_v2_interrupt carries an idempotent cancel command and expected run version; acknowledge only an observed terminal RunRecord and resolve races by durable Run version.

required_tests: Running health query never resets the UI locally.
Recognized waiting remains visible and cancellable.
Query timeout retains active_run_id and shows recovery.
Cancel replay and cancel/completion/reconciliation races produce exactly one terminal projection.

findings.root_cause: Stage-failure replay identity includes transient Run/call/effect IDs and cannot distinguish blind replay from an explicit retry generation.
evidence: Existing stage-failure identity includes transient Run/call/effect IDs.
A fresh replay may call source resolution again before an exact-commit identity is known.
Intentional user retry is not distinguished from blind replay.

minimal_protocol.failure_identity: Fingerprint owner scope, normalized URL/ref and stable source input; exclude transient Run/call/effect IDs.
minimal_protocol.durable_record: Persist stable code/message/retryable/receipt, attempt generation and terminal status. Same nonretryable generation replays without source work.
minimal_protocol.explicit_retry: Only an explicit policy-permitted retry increments generation idempotently; unchanged intrinsically invalid input remains suppressed.
minimal_protocol.presentation: Return stable public failure fields and allowed actions; stop install progress within five seconds and never automatically re-enter identical nonretryable staging.

required_tests: Same nonretryable failure calls source resolution once across replay/restart.
Duplicate retry commands are idempotent and changed input creates a new identity.
The UI settles within five seconds of rejection.
Failure versus cancel produces one terminal Run state.

conclusion.summary: Replace local timeout reset with authoritative versioned Run query/cancel convergence and give stage failures a stable input-derived identity plus explicit retry generation.
